map_source: NOAA ENC Direct-to-GIS coastal MapServer rendered basemap, EPSG:4326 extent -77.533333..-74.866667 lon and 36..40 lat, classified and resampled to 500 m cells
notes: All measurements are synthetic global-bearing sensor reports generated from the 2023-07-15 AIS snapshot and current charted aids. They are not measured visual detections. The 500 m water mask is classified from the NOAA ENC rendered basemap and is a coarse geometry approximation, not a vector shoreline ground truth.
raw_data_policy: Raw AIS rows and rendered map raster are not included; only site coordinates and aggregate experiment results are committed.
